plaatsen.tekst: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend
They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together
